parameters.query: with candidate as (select l.id, l.email, l.source_tool, l.intent, l.stack_recommendation from leads l left join clicks c on c.lead_id = l.id where c.id is null and l.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and not exists (select 1 from nurture_sends ns where ns.lead_id = l.id and ns.sequence_step = 'reengagement-0') order by l.created_at asc for update skip locked limit 50), claimed as (insert into nurture_sends(lead_id, sequence_step, status, claimed_at) select id, 'reengagement-0', 'claimed', now() from candidate on conflict do nothing returning lead_id) select c.* from candidate c join claimed cl on cl.lead_id = c.id;

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value: =[{"role":"system","content":"Write a short re-engagement email. Reference the tool but never name a brand. Return JSON with subject and body."},{"role":"user","content":"Source tool: {{$json.source_tool}} Intent: {{JSON.stringify($json.intent)}}"}]

parameters.query: update nurture_sends set status = 'sent', sent_at = now() where lead_id = '{{$('Claim leads before send').item.json.id}}' and sequence_step = 'reengagement-0';
